pr_body:
Adds support for VirtualBox 7.0. The 7.0 driver includes a
port forward fix to account for missing port forward information
in the `showvminfo` output when more than one port forward has
been defined on a vm. This is been isolated to just the 7.0.0
VirtualBox release. It will revert to the original behavior on
the VirtualBox 7.0.1 release.

The VirtualBox extension pack was required to prevent the
`VBoxManage` executable from hanging on multiple executions. The
underlying cause of this has still not been determined and is
being investigated.

Fixes #12947 #12950
